source: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, MapServer layer 28 (Flood Hazard Zones)
download_method: 96 tiled public ArcGIS GeoJSON requests, deduplicated by FEMA OBJECTID
geometry_generalization: maxAllowableOffset=0.001 degrees, approximately 111 meters, suitable for 1 km radar-cell center context only
interpretation_limit: Flood-zone context is not flood depth, parcel advice, a flood forecast, or proof that all of a radar cell is exposed.
